ideas.idea: Fix canonical using Astro.url and Astro.site (item 2 fix)
ideas.why: Part of the known canonical problem, but the report's added requirement of setting site in astro config is a concrete step; still, the canonical issue itself is known.

ideas.idea: Replace Article JSON-LD on moorings with Service/Product with offers (£40/night), not just fix comma
ideas.why: The Article type with no author or date is a poor fit for a pricing page, and offers markup would describe the actual content.

ideas.idea: Render the FAQ questions and answers visibly on the home page to match the FAQ JSON-LD
ideas.why: index.astro injects FAQ JSON-LD while the page shows only an h1 and one sentence, so markup does not match visible content.

ideas.idea: Add astro.config.mjs with site and @astrojs/sitemap integration instead of hand-maintained sitemap
ideas.why: No astro config exists, the sitemap is hand-written without lastmod, and absolute URLs need site.

ideas.idea: Replace placeholder harbor.example domain with the production domain
ideas.why: The domain is clearly a placeholder, but the fix needs the real domain from the owner and is a deployment step.

ideas.idea: Add meta charset, viewport, Open Graph/Twitter tags and favicon to Base.astro
ideas.why: Base.astro head has only title, description, canonical and robots, so charset and viewport are missing and the claim is accurate.

ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness/Organization schema with address, phone and hours on the homepage
ideas.why: No entity markup exists and the site is a local harbour business with a phone number on the contact page.

ideas.idea: Align Harbor/harbour spelling in index title and put the Falmouth keyword in the title
ideas.why: The title says 'Harbor moorings in Cornwall' while the H1 and description say Falmouth harbour, an actual inconsistency.

ideas.idea: Expand home page content on mooring types, booking and water taxi
ideas.why: Page content is thin, but this is general 'add more content' advice with no specific facts to anchor it.

ideas.idea: Add a real pricing table with sizes and seasons on the moorings page
ideas.why: The description promises sizes and seasonal prices but the page only says prices start at £40 a night.

ideas.idea: Make the phone number a tel: link and add address and email on contact page
ideas.why: The contact page has the number as plain text only, so a tel: link and fuller details help people and machines.

ideas.idea: Switch Newsletter from client:load to a static component or client:visible
ideas.why: It reverses the deliberate choice to use client:load for the form, and the form is not the main content.

ideas.idea: Add a default title and brand suffix to the layout
ideas.why: Accurate but low impact; titles are already passed on every page.
The report itself calls it optional and not a ranking factor, and the absence is a deliberate choice.
